test_MapInfra_caching: test the MapInfra caching behavior by running process on a pydantic model with folder and cluster config
test_to_chunks: test the to_chunks function to split a list into evenly sized chunks with configurable max chunks and min items per chunk
test_map_infra_pickling: test that a MapInfra-wrapped pydantic model can be pickled and unpickled while preserving the infra decorator override
test_map_infra_modes: test the MapInfra cached force and read-only modes to verify recomputation and cache-only behavior
test_make_pool_executor_fallback: test the _make_pool_executor fallback from ProcessPoolExecutor to ThreadPoolExecutor when sem_open raises PermissionError
